\section{Agreement with DataDecide}
\label{app:rq07_external_frameworks}

\begin{rqfinding}
1. Both corpora rank the three gated shared tasks the same way (ARC Easy $>$ HellaSwag $>$ ARC Challenge; Spearman $\rho$ 1.00, Pearson r of log$_{10}$ SNR 0.87, p = 0.33), but three points are too few for the agreement to be evidence. (Figure~\ref{fig:app_rq07_external_frameworks}.)

2. \textbf{Same order, n = 3.} \texttt{aad} SNR is 1.09 / 0.87 / 0.52 on our ladder and 9.76 / 5.04 / 4.16 on DataDecide for ARC Easy / HellaSwag / ARC Challenge.

3. \textbf{Our SNR is 5.8--9.0$\times$ smaller.} DataDecide's \texttt{aad} SNR exceeds ours by 9.0$\times$ on ARC Easy, 5.8$\times$ on HellaSwag and 7.9$\times$ on ARC Challenge; the log-scale correlation ignores this offset, so compare orders across corpora, never SNR levels.
\end{rqfinding}

\paragraph{Question.} Do the SNR variants and the ``reliable benchmark'' set we find on our ladder also hold on AllenAI's DataDecide / OLMo corpus, on the English benchmarks both share?

\paragraph{Setup.} Our 1B rung (seed 1904, every cell and data build) against DataDecide's 1B rung (25 data recipes), on the English tasks both evaluate that clear the above-chance gate on our side; SNR as the average absolute deviation over noise, compared on a log scale.
